references.text: The wave offering and the breast are given to Aaron and his sons as a perpetual right from the Israelites, confirming the principle of the priests' share.
The wave offering and the shoulder shall be eaten by Aaron and his sons as their allotted portion from the peace offerings of the Israelites.
The Lord gives the heave offerings to the priests as a perpetual right and describes the holy gifts that belong to them.
An everlasting covenant of salt for Aaron and his descendants, confirming the eternal arrangement of heave offerings for the priests.
The rightful share of the priests from the people's offering, including the shoulder, confirms the eternal order for the priesthood.
The context of the heave offering and wave offering that are consecrated from the ordination ram for Aaron and his sons.
The right shoulder shall be given to the priest as a heave offering from the peace offering, a parallel to the eternal arrangement described in Exodus.
Both verses state that heave offerings from the Israelites belong to Aaron and his descendants as an eternal arrangement.
Numbers 18:8 provides the theological basis for heave offerings belonging to Aaron, which Exodus 29:28 specifies.
Lev 22:18 defines the offering (heave/voluntary), while Exod 29:28 defines the recipient of this specific offering.
